description:
Propose one team rule when the person corrects a design, copy or UX choice you made and the correction should hold for every future build, such as "no gradients on buttons" or "say workspace, never project". Do not propose a fix that only this task needs.

The rule waits for the person: no agent follows it until they approve it on the Team rules page. After the call, tell the person the rule in one line and where to approve it.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used only for usage analytics; does not change the result.

rule.description: The rule as one sentence, in the person's own terms. Up to 500 characters.

where.description: The screens, components or copy it covers. Up to 200 characters.

why.description: Why the rule exists, from what the person said. Up to 300 characters.

name: propose-team-rule
title: Propose a Team Rule
